title: Annual Harvest & Michaelmas Festival Celebrated at Roshni Village
summary: Residents of Roshni Village, children of Green Earth School, and visiting parents gathered to celebrate our annual Autumn Harvest with freshly baked stone-oven sourdough bread.
content: Over 250 friends, villagers, and well-wishers joined us under Lahore's autumn skies. The festival included traditional music, lantern walks, and a theatrical presentation celebrating courage and solidarity.

title: New Stone Flour Mill Installed in Organic Bakery
summary: Our organic bakery workshop has installed a traditional stone flour mill, enabling resident bakers to mill fresh desi wheat directly harvested from our biodynamic fields.
content: The mill produces 100% whole-grain, stone-ground flour retaining all essential wheatgerm oils. Our sourdough loaves are now more flavorful and nourishing than ever before.

title: Kindergarten Spring Botanical Garden Project at Green Earth School
summary: Village pupils planted their own circular herb and flower beds, learning natural botanical cycles through direct hands-on engagement with mother earth.
content: Guided by our master gardener and class teachers, children sowed seeds of marigold, coriander, and sunflowers. Every morning starts with watering their living classroom gardens.

title: Autumn Volunteer Cohort Welcomed to Roshni Village
summary: Volunteers from Germany, Switzerland, and local Lahore universities joined us for a 6-month residency assisting in our craft studios and school.
content: Our new volunteers will live on-site, sharing meals and daily chores while helping in the handloom weaving studio, carpentry workshop, and remedial physiotherapy sessions.
